import java.util.*;

public class Main {

    static final int MAXN = 300;

    static final int ROOM = -1;
    static final int REAC = -2;
    static final int BAD_REAC = -3;
    static final int CAPS = ROOM;

    static class Aresta {
        int from, to, rev, flow, cap;

        Aresta() {}

        Aresta(int _from, int _to, int _rev, int _flow, int _cap) {
            from = _from;
            to = _to;
            rev = _rev;
            flow = _flow;
            cap = _cap;
        }

        int residuo() {
            return cap - flow;
        }
    }

    static class EdmondsKarp {
        int size;
        List<Aresta>[] grafo;
        Aresta[] prev;
        boolean[] vis;

        EdmondsKarp(int tam) {
            size = tam;
            grafo = new List[size];
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                grafo[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            prev = new Aresta[size];
            vis = new boolean[size];
        }

        void limpa() {
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                grafo[i].clear();
            }
        }

        void add(int s, int t, int cap) {
            Aresta a = new Aresta(s, t, grafo[t].size(), 0, cap);
            Aresta b = new Aresta(t, s, grafo[s].size(), 0, 0);
            grafo[s].add(a);
            grafo[t].add(b);
        }

        void undirectedAdd(int s, int t, int cap) {
            Aresta a = new Aresta(s, t, grafo[t].size(), 0, cap);
            Aresta b = new Aresta(t, s, grafo[s].size(), 0, cap);
            grafo[s].add(a);
            grafo[t].add(b);
        }

        boolean bfs(int source, int sink) {
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                prev[i] = null;
                vis[i] = false;
            }

            Queue<Integer> fila = new LinkedList<>();
            fila.push(source);
            vis[source] = true;

            int atual;
            while (!fila.isEmpty()) {
                atual = fila.poll();

                if (atual == sink) return true;

                for (Aresta a : grafo[atual]) {
                    if (!vis[a.to] && a.residuo() > 0) {
                        prev[a.to] = a;
                        vis[a.to] = true;
                        fila.push(a.to);
                    }
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        int dfs(int source, int sink) {
            int flow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            int v = sink;
            while (v != source) {
                flow = Math.min(flow, prev[v].residuo());
                v = prev[v].from;
            }

            v = sink;
            Aresta a;
            while (v != source) {
                a = prev[v];
                a.flow += flow;
                grafo[a.to].get(a.rev).flow -= flow;
                v = a.from;
            }
            return flow;
        }

        long flow(int source, int sink) {
            long flow = 0;
            while (bfs(source, sink)) {
                flow += dfs(source, sink);
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static int[][] station = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] checkpoint = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][][] veneno = new int[61][MAXN][MAXN];

    static class Coord {
        int x, y, qtd;

        Coord(int a, int b, int c) {
            x = a;
            y = b;
            qtd = c;
        }

        boolean is_valid(int N) {
            return (x >= 0 && x < N && y >= 0 && y < N && station[x][y] == ROOM);
        }
    }

    static boolean is_valid(int x, int y, int N) {
        return new Coord(x, y, 0).is_valid(N);
    }

    static int[] moveX = {-1, 0, 1, 0}; // ^ < v >
    static int[] moveY = {0, -1, 0, 1}; // ^ < v >

    static int trad(char ch) {
        switch (ch) {
            case '0': case '1': case '2': case '3': case '4': case '5': case '6': case '7': case '8': case '9':
                return ROOM;
            case 'Y':
                return REAC;
            case 'Z':
                return BAD_REAC;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    static int how_much(char ch) {
        return ch - '0';
    }

    static int bfs(Coord from, Coord to, int N) {
        boolean[][] vis = new boolean[MAXN][MAXN];
        Queue<Pair<Integer, Coord>> fila = new LinkedList<>();
        fila.add(new Pair<>(0, from));
        vis[from.x][from.y] = true;

        while (!fila.isEmpty()) {
            int tempo = fila.peek().getKey();
            Coord atual = fila.poll().getValue();

            if (atual.x == to.x && atual.y == to.y) return tempo;

            if (veneno[tempo][atual.x][atual.y] == 1) {
                continue;
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                Coord next = new Coord(atual.x + moveX[i], atual.y + moveY[i], 0);
                if (next.is_valid(N) && !vis[next.x][next.y]) {
                    if (veneno[tempo][next.x][next.y] == 0) {
                        fila.add(new Pair<>(tempo + 1, next));
                        vis[next.x][next.y] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return 999;
    }

    static void espalha_veneno(int x, int y, int T, int N) {
        veneno[0][x][y] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= T; i++) {
            for (int lin = 0; lin < N; lin++) {
                for (int col = 0; col < N; col++) {
                    if (veneno[i - 1][lin][col] == 1) {
                        veneno[i][lin][col] = 1;
                        for (int move = 0; move < 4; move++) {
                            if (is_valid(lin + moveX[move], col + moveY[move], N)) {
                                veneno[i][lin + moveX[move]][col + moveY[move]] = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static class Pair<K, V> {
        private K key;
        private V value;

        public Pair(K key, V value) {
            this.key = key;
            this.value = value;
        }

        public K getKey() {
            return key;
        }

        public V getValue() {
            return value;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = scanner.nextInt();
        int T = scanner.nextInt();

        scanner.nextLine(); // consume newline

        char[][] grid1 = new char[N][N];
        List<Coord> pessoas = new ArrayList<>();
        Coord bad = new Coord(0, 0, 0);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                grid1[i][j] = ch;
                if (trad(ch) == ROOM && how_much(ch) > 0) {
                    pessoas.add(new Coord(i, j, how_much(ch)));
                }
                station[i][j] = trad(ch);
                if (station[i][j] == BAD_REAC) {
                    bad = new Coord(i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        List<Coord> capsulas = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (trad(ch) == CAPS && how_much(ch) > 0) {
                    Coord c = new Coord(i, j, how_much(ch));
                    capsulas.add(c);
                    checkpoint[i][j] = how_much(ch);
                }
            }
        }

        EdmondsKarp din = new EdmondsKarp(MAXN);
        int sink = MAXN - 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < pessoas.size(); i++) {
            din.add(0, i * 2 + 1, pessoas.get(i).qtd);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < capsulas.size(); i++) {
            din.add(i * 2 + 2, sink, capsulas.get(i).qtd);
        }

        espalha_veneno(bad.x, bad.y, T, N);

        for (int i = 0; i < pessoas.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < capsulas.size(); j++) {
                int tempo = bfs(pessoas.get(i), capsulas.get(j), N);
                if (tempo <= T) {
                    din.add(i * 2 + 1, j * 2 + 2, 999);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(din.flow(0, sink));
    }
}
